decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
one shared scale: one scale for every panel, so that sizes compare across panels (G7.48)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
a legend instead of end labels: the label of B.C. would move 3.4 line heights from its line (at most 1.5 with a leader) (G5.3, G5.7)
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
the unit phrase on the top label: “200 orders per month”; the top gridline starts after it
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
legend entries in the order of the lines at the latest point: Ontario, Quebec, B.C., Manitoba, Alberta, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Saskatchewan, Newfoundland, N.W.T. & Nunavut, P.E.I., Yukon
the legend at the right of the plot, beside the latest values, centred on the plot

findings.message: panels.arrangement series in each panel by province or territory departs from the procedure, which gives rows by province or territory (no comparison within a panel is stated (facts.compare): one series per panel, the most panels and the least clutter (13-15 DP-1); 12 panels are stacked in rows (more than 6 across would be too narrow))
findings.reason: the book's spaghetti chart: every series in one chart
findings.title: the arrangement of small multiples chosen for the insight, from the range of candidates

findings.message: 12 lines in one chart, crossing 30 times, not labelled directly: a general audience gets fewer series per panel, more panels (G1.20; five lines, D-28, a provisional threshold)
findings.title: no single chart of many overlapping series for a general audience

findings.message: 12 lines crossing 30 times, not labelled directly: more than five lines only if they rarely cross (about once per line) and are labelled directly; else small multiples (G1.20, D-28)
findings.title: at most about five lines, more only if they rarely cross and are labelled directly

findings.message: 12 regular colours: beyond eight they cannot be told apart; drop, group or merge categories, or label every series directly (G4.19, G4.21, D-14)
findings.reason: the book's spaghetti chart (s. 0202, right), rebuilt: twelve colours
findings.title: at most eight regular colours

findings.message: #558bb9 and #9a77b7 are 0.018 apart under deuteranopia (at least 0.06): readers with colour-vision deficiency may not tell them apart (G4.18, D-34)
findings.title: colours that must be told apart survive colour-vision deficiency
